name: Mixedbread
short: Search-and-retrieval platform shipping its own Toast 1 agent model plus a managed indexing and search stack, with a free Starter plan and a $20/month Scale plan billed at flat per-unit usage rates.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free with $5 one-time credits, no card required; 3 workspace users, 3 stores, 100 queries/min, 6,000 uploads/min.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $20/month included as credits, then pay-as-you-go at the standard rates; unlimited workspace users, 10,000 stores, 2,400 queries/min.

plans.name: Toast 1 (agent model)
plans.notes: 40% launch discount off the $0.50/$1.20 regular rate; cached input $0.036; cache writes free. Search usage billed separately.
